operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return a comma separated value (CSV) file of the facilities found.

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return GeoJSON of the facilities found.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] cwa rest services geojson [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output p pretty print qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 5 cwa feature geo properties

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a clustered get_facility_info query, download cluster facility information as either a CSV or GEOJSON file.
operations.summary: Clean Water Act (CWA) Info Clusters Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] cwa rest services info clusters [PARAMS] output p pretty print qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The purpose of the GET_MAP service is to display facility coordinates and facility clusters related to a get_facilities facility query. Currently, the maximum number of coordinates returned is 500. GET_MAP performs automatic clustering at the state, county, and zip code levels to maximize the number of coordinates returned.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] cwa rest services map [PARAMS] 1 2 c callback id lat long output p qid tablelist [SCHEMA] 3 cwa data map output

operations.description: GET_QID is passed with a query ID corresponding to a previously run get_facilities query. It then returns a Facility object containing all matching facilities. The main purpose of GET_QID is for large querysets that contain multiple pages (responsesets) of output. GET_QID allows for pagination and for the selection and sorting of columns.
operations.summary: Clean Water Act (CWA) Paginated Results Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] cwa rest services qid [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output pageno qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 1 4 cwa facilities results

operations.description: Returns the JSON Object Name and ColumnId for usage with the qcolumns parameter for get_qid, get_facility_info and other service endpoints.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] cwa rest services metadata [PARAMS] callback output [SCHEMA] 1 2 met
